propositions: write-side transient filesystem faults (unable to create temporary file, failed to insert into database, unable to index file) are only retried in event_append but not in other run_git_write callers like s3_doctor, causing CI failures on runner filesystem blips
gitutil.run_git_write composes transient retry logic that only matches read-side fault signatures (could not parse head, bad object) and lacks coverage for write-side loose-object temp-create faults
the identical write-side marker family is defined twice (once in gitutil read-side, once in event_append), causing asymmetric retry behavior across the codebase
moving write-side markers into shared gitutil seam and unifying the retry logic ensures all run_git_write callers inherit bounded transient retry for filesystem faults
corrupt-object signatures (loose object is corrupt, inflate: data stream error) and index.lock faults must remain excluded from retry to preserve failure visibility
